title: Price Ceilings and Shortages
subject: Economics
summary: Reason from changes in quantity supplied and demanded under a binding price ceiling.

learning_objectives.text: Apply supply-and-demand reasoning to a binding price ceiling

concepts.label: Binding price ceiling
concepts.reference_explanation: A price ceiling below equilibrium is binding: quantity demanded rises while quantity supplied falls, producing a shortage.
key_points: A ceiling below equilibrium is binding
Quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied and creates a shortage
common_misconceptions: A lower legal price always makes the product available to more people

concepts.label: Supply response
concepts.reference_explanation: Producer incentives affect quantity supplied, so a subsidy can shift supply and change the size of a shortage.
key_points: Producer incentives can change quantity supplied
common_misconceptions: Supply never changes after a policy
